name: tezca-android-development
description: Native Android development with Google's recommended architecture: set up a multi-module Jetpack Compose app (Hilt, Navigation 3, Room 3, DataStore, Retrofit or Ktor, coroutines/Flow, lifecycle ViewModel, convention plugins, CI/CD) either fully native or on top of a Kotlin Multiplatform SDK, then grow it feature by feature: APIs, Room DAOs, preferences, offline-first repositories, single-responsibility use cases, ViewModels, screens, tests, third-party SDKs and quality audits.
